name: Continuous access evaluation (CAE)
short_description: Continuous access evaluation is a Microsoft Entra capability that lets services revoke or re-evaluate access tokens in near real time when critical events such as a rising user risk occur, instead of waiting for the token to expire.

evidence.quote: There is a technology called continuous access evaluation that can help with tokens.
access evaluation or CAE is how Microsoft revokes access immediately if something changes
Continuous access evaluation or CAE is near real-time revocation of tokens and sessions
